instruction: Create a subfolder called 'Receipts' inside the existing 'Bills' local folder in Thunderbird.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully created two local folders (COMPANY, UNIVERSITY) by right-clicking Local Folders, selecting New Folder, typing name, and clicking Create Folder. Completed in 9 turns.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate Thunderbird sidebar, right-click context menus, create local folders via New Folder dialog, type folder names
metadata.task_rationale: Tests subfolder creation inside an existing folder, which is a natural extension of the demonstrated folder creation capability but requires navigating to a specific parent folder first
metadata.explanation: Task requires creating a subfolder Receipts under existing Bills folder. When a subfolder is created in Thunderbird, it creates a Bills.sbd directory containing Receipts and Receipts.msf. Evaluator uses ls -R and check_list to verify the .sbd directory and subfolder entries exist.

scoring_breakdown.bills_sbd: 0.34 - Bills.sbd directory exists (proves subfolder was created under Bills)

llm_judge_reasons: Postconfig correctly uses 'ls -R' on the Thunderbird Local Folders directory to capture filesystem state after task completion
cache_file getter correctly reads the ls output for check_list metric consumption
Parameter handling is correct: expected.type='rule' → get_rule returns rules dict → check_list receives {'expect': [...]} and accesses rules.get('expect', []) properly
Regex pattern '\bBills\.sbd\b' correctly verifies the .sbd directory that Thunderbird creates when a folder has subfolders
Regex pattern '\bReceipts\.msf\b' correctly verifies the mail summary file for the Receipts subfolder
Regex pattern '\bReceipts/?(?!\.msf)' uses negative lookahead to correctly match the Receipts mbox file/directory while excluding Receipts.msf, ensuring the actual folder storage exists
All three patterns together provide comprehensive verification that the subfolder was created in the correct location under Bills
Coverage is complete: the instruction requires creating subfolder 'Receipts' inside 'Bills', and the evaluator verifies both the parent .sbd structure and the child folder artifacts
